summary: Bound ordinary forwarded client reads and stop their timed-out relay futures.

replay.detail: No replay, heal or projection-health behavior change. Heal-next is a mutating protocol step, not an ordinary read.

schema.detail: No table, index, schema version or claim vocabulary change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or authority change.

compatibility.detail: Forwarded read envelopes use15s including body/queue/relay/response work, plus only the supported operation long-poll wait (capped10s), rather than120s bulk. Timeout drops the blocking handler-owned relay future and returns typed504/read-deadline through gateways. Terminal actions keep mutation acknowledgement semantics; public30s long-poll and120s bulk/doctor budgets remain.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon rollout required; restart and mixed-version behavior not independently qualified.

manual.detail: No settings or data repair required.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores the previous forwarding budget; no data migration.
